decision: installed pstack skills (poteto-mode, principles, how, architect, arena, unslop, technical-writing and friends) into .claude/skills, skipping the Cloudflare-specific ones
why: the user asked for them and only repo content survives a cloud session; the same copy also went to ~/.claude/skills so this session can use them now
result: skills listed by the Skill tool

decision: chose prior art to learn from: OverDrive (MIT sentry app for DiLink 3/4/5), BYD Extend (camera overlays), byd-dolphin-hacking (DiLink 3 reverse engineering)
why: the hard part is reading car cameras from a third-party app; these projects already solved it on the same Android 10 platform family

decision: build APKs without the Android SDK: Ubuntu aapt2, apksigner, zipalign and dx, android.jar from Sable/android-platforms, kotlinc from GitHub releases
why: the proxy blocks dl.google.com and every Google Maven mirror we tried, and the Android Gradle Plugin stops at 2.3.0 on Maven Central
result: probe APK signed with v3 scheme and verified by apksigner

decision: compile Kotlin with -Xlambdas=class and -Xsam-conversions=class, and strip META-INF/versions from library jars before dexing
why: dx has no desugaring for invokedynamic and aborts on multi-release module-info.class
result: probe classes.dex built from app classes plus kotlin-stdlib
